text:
maria: Heads-up — after the fused-attn kernel switch landed on canary we see end-to-end perf regression on 8x A100 NVSwitch tests. P95 latency +18% and throughput down ~12%.
keenan: ack, saw the alert. profiler shows long idle windows during backward where all-reduce isn't overlapping compute.
sanjay: can you paste the perf output? curious if it's a ring imbalance or kernel micro-ops.
maria: pasted below from run (reduced):
```
TIMELINE(ms)  OP        GPU0   GPU1   GPU2   GPU3   ALLREDUCE
0-50          compute  45     44     46     45    6.2
50-100        allred   1.1    1.2    12.3   1.0    85.4
100-150       compute  48     47     49     48    3.8
```
keenan: that 12.3 spike on GPU2 looks like a hot-path waiting on PCIe->host fallback. topology shows GPU2 in a different NVLink ring (bridge via PCIe to other node).
olivia: so it's not the fused-attn math per-se, it's the placement + kernel choosing a comm pattern that assumes full NVLink mesh.
sanjay: also saw KV cache churn when microbatch size drops below 16 — new batching heuristic evicts prefixes more aggressively, causing cache misses and extra host-device round trips. That exacerbates the all-reduce gap.
maria: good point — server logs show more kvcache-evict entries around the same iterations. sample: `kvcache_evict_count=234 -> 410` after the patch.
infra-bot: deploy canary: inference-cluster/canary-8gpu/2026-11-21T08:12:21 deployed (rev f7c2).
keenan: quick theory: fused-attn_v2 picked a fused matmul+attn kernel that increases device-side compute shadow time but reduces small p2p pipelining opportunities. On NVSwitch mesh that's fine, on mixed-PCIe rings it prevents overlap.
olivia: actionable: revert fused-attn kernel selection in canary, run targeted job with forced kernel=matmul_fallback + old batching heuristic, and capture p2p traces. Can we also run a reduce-scatter topology-aware engine test?
sanjay: I'll run a reduce-scatter vs ring-allreduce comparison with topo hints (NVLink groups vs cross-node) and a kvcache log level to capture evicts.
maria: timeline: revert now on canary, run tests by EOD, tag perf ticket RW-1427. If that shows improvement, schedule rollout pause.
keenan: note — long-term fix: kernel selector should pick comm-friendly variants when topology is non-uniform and when pipeline-parallel microbatches are small. add a cost model: extra device-to-host hops + kvcache miss penalty.
olivia: agreed. I'll add a design note to the perf epic: "topology-aware kernel selection + batching heuristic". cc @sanjay for perf numbers. :eyes:
maria: thanks — next steps tracked in RW-1427, attaching profiler traces in the ticket.
infra-bot: perf job queued: perf/8gpu/topo-aware/1805001200 (ETA 35m).
keenan: also flag for ops: these mixed-link machines should probably be labeled so scheduler avoids placing pipeline stages across PCIe bridges unless necessary.
sanjay: running the first reduce-scatter run now, will paste logs when done.
maria: great, thanks everyone.
